utilisateurs.description: Platform accounts. Filter by status or organization.

employes.description: Employee profiles linked to users and organizations.

nouveau.description: Link an existing user to an organization.

moyens-paiement.description: Cards and payment methods saved by users.

sessions.description: Active sessions. Revoke a session to sign the user out.

hebergements.title: Accommodations
hebergements.description: Properties, rooms and amenities. Filter by destination.

nouveau.description: Create the property then add images, amenities and rooms.

equipements.description: Global catalog reused across accommodations (Wi-Fi, pool, etc.).

organisations.title: Organizations
organisations.description: Platform partners and entities. Search by name or slug.

comptes.title: Loyalty accounts
comptes.description: OneKey program — point balance, tiers and last activity. Manual adjustment reserved for super admin.

activites.title: Activities & tours
activites.description: Experiences, providers and time slots by destination.

nouveau.description: Create an experience then add schedules on the edit page.

destinations.title: Destinations
destinations.description: Geography and points of interest. Search by name, slug or country code.

nouveau.description: Create the destination then add points of interest on the edit page.

locations.title: Vehicle rentals
locations.description: Vehicles by agency, categories and availability slots.

nouveau.description: Link an agency and category, then set availability slots.

vols.description: Flight catalog, cabin classes and availability. Search by flight code.

nouveau.description: Define the route, then add cabin classes on the flight page.

croisieres.description: Scheduled departures, itineraries, cabins and availability.

nouveau.description: Link an existing itinerary to a departure date.
Create a ship then add itineraries and cabins.

forfaits.description: Combined packages with discount and price calculated from included products.

nouveau.description: Create the package then add items on the edit page.

reservations.description: Paginated booking list (live API data). Filter by status, date, customer and organization. Requires bookings.read.

lignes.description: Global line items per booking (live API data). Filter by type, booking status and booking ID. Requires bookings.read.

paiements.description: Stripe transactions and refunds (test mode). Filter by status, dates and organization (super admin). Access: payments.read; refund: payments.write.

codes-promo.intro: Codes entered at checkout (e.g. WELCOME10). Complements promotions. Access: promo_codes.read / write.

nouveau.description: The code will be uppercased and can be entered as-is at checkout.

promotions.intro: Marketing campaigns with optional discount (checkout via promotionId). Complements promo codes. Access: promo_codes.read / write.

nouveau.description: Define the campaign, optional discount and validity dates.

tickets.description: Customer support requests. Filter by status and priority. Access: support_tickets.read / support_tickets.write.

avis.description: Moderate customer ratings and comments. Filter by score, property and status. Actions: approve, hide or delete. Access: reviews.read / reviews.write.

roles.title: Roles & permissions
roles.description: Manage roles, permission matrix and user assignments.

nouveau.description: Create a custom role and define its permissions.

permissions.title: Permission catalog
permissions.description: Read-only list of permissions available on the platform.

assignations.title: Role assignments
assignations.description: Assign or revoke roles for users (all scopes).

audit.title: RBAC audit
audit.description: Security event log and permission changes (read-only).
